n: Pinnguaq Introduction to Machine Learning and NLP
t: A lesson on natural language processing with unplugged tasks and a Teachable Machine project.
steps: Find the Pinnguaq lesson Introduction to Machine Learning NLP online.
Read the whole lesson online. It has no downloadable files.
Choose a short text for the unplugged tasks.
Open Teachable Machine on a test device and allow the microphone.
Prepare a device that can play dog and cat sounds.
Plan the closing talk on privacy and voice assistants.
